subject: Incident summary: missing course
body:
Programs office incident summary

The keypad recorded the CEO's code overnight. Thomas had described the course as a cash grab that could damage our reputation and asked Finance about refunds. The current course audit names Priya Nair and gives the status as cancelled by Marketing. We should follow those records carefully.

Marketing's messages over the last weeks are worth reading.

Security and Programs saw the pale figure and gave chase. Perhaps the Grey Lecturer has finally found a deadline — with a wink. For the review, please send original records alongside accounts of what happened. Programs is collecting the material with teaching and IT input.
title: Incident summary: missing course
author_credit: Programs office (S. Kowalski), with input from M. Fenwick and P. Nair
